# Columbia.com

> > Columbia.com appears to be a corporate portal providing employee access to internal systems, document management, and virtual desktop infrastructure.

This site serves as an enterprise gateway for Columbia employees, offering authentication to DocumentPortal and Omnissa Horizon virtual desktop services. The classified pages also include unrelated entertainment content from TV Guide and Know Your Meme, which may indicate a crawling error or multi-domain corporate ownership.
